name: Jerzner Hof
beschreibung: The 4-star Jerzner Hof welcomes travelers to a sunny panoramic plateau in Jerzens in the Pitztal Valley, surrounded by sweeping alpine peaks. This family-managed hotel harmonizes genuine Tyrolean hospitality with contemporary high-end amenities. A key highlight is the expansive 1,400 m² wellness and spa sanctuary, featuring an indoor pool, heated year-round outdoor pool, sauna complex, and scenic relaxation lounges. Culinary experiences revolve around seasonal regional ingredients and creative gastronomy. In winter, the local ski shuttle connects seamlessly to the snow-sure Hochzeiger ski slopes, while summer hiking trails depart right from the property.
kurzbeschreibung: Exclusive 4-star wellness hotel in Jerzens in the Pitztal Valley featuring 1,400 m² of spa, pools, and gourmet dining.
